name: Email Trigger (IMAP)
category_description: Core node - built-in logic, data or generic API functionality
description: Use the IMAP Email node to receive emails using an IMAP email server. This node is a trigger node

parameters.name: Credential to connect with
parameters.description: Select or create an IMAP credential to connect to the server with

parameters.name: Mailbox Name
parameters.description: Enter the mailbox from which you want to receive emails

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: Choose whether you want an email marked as read when n8n receives it. None will leave it marked unread. Mark as Read will mark it as read

parameters.name: Download Attachments
parameters.description: This toggle controls whether to download email attachments (turned on) or not (turned off). Only set this if necessary, since it increases processing

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: Choose the format to return the message in from these options:

parameters.name: Custom Email Rules
parameters.description: Enter custom email fetching rules to determine which emails the node fetches

parameters.name: Force Reconnect Every Minutes
parameters.description: Set an interval in minutes to force reconnection

parameters.name: postProcessAction
parameters.description: What to do after the email has been received. If "nothing" gets selected it will be processed multiple times.

parameters.name: downloadAttachments
parameters.description: Whether attachments of emails should be downloaded. Only set if needed as it increases processing.

parameters.name: format

options.name: RAW
options.description: Returns the full email message data with body content in the raw field as a base64url encoded string; the payload field is not used

options.name: Resolved
options.description: Returns the full email with all data resolved and attachments saved as binary data

options.name: Simple
options.description: Returns the full email; do not use if you wish to gather inline attachments

parameters.description: The format to return the message in

parameters.name: dataPropertyAttachmentsPrefixName
parameters.description: Prefix for name of the binary property to which to write the attachments. An index starting with 0 will be added. So if name is "attachment_" the first attachment is saved to "attachment_0"

parameters.name: dataPropertyAttachmentsPrefixName
parameters.description: Prefix for name of the binary property to which to write the attachments. An index starting with 0 will be added. So if name is "attachment_" the first attachment is saved to "attachment_0"

options.name: customEmailConfig
options.description: Custom email fetching rules. See node-imap's search function for more details.

options.name: forceReconnect
options.description: Sets an interval (in minutes) to force a reconnection

options.name: trackLastMessageId
options.description: Whether to fetch only new emails since the last run, or all emails that match the "Custom Email Rules" (["UNSEEN"] by default)
